simple.meaning: מַטָּה (maṭṭâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “downward , below or beneath ; often adverbially with or without prefixes.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 26:24. The surrounding context includes altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַטָּה (H4295) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: downward , below or beneath ; often adverbially with or without prefixes
definitions.usage: beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).
definitions.full: H4295. mattah מָ֑֫טָּה מַ֫טָּה, adverb downwards (from [ מַט ] for [ מַטֶּה ] a place of declension (compare נָטָה , 3a ), with ָ ה locative, Ol 222b Kö ii. 280: compare the opposed to מַ֫עְלָהִ , below עָלָה ): — 1 alone , Deut 28:43 and thou shalt descend מָ֑֫טָּה מַ֫טָּה downwards, downwards , i.e. lower and lower, Prov 15:24 מ מִשְּׁאוֺל סוּר ׳לְמַעַן . 2 לְמַ֫טָּה : a. downwards Deut 28:13 למ תִהְיֶה ׳וְלֹא , Isa 37:31 = 2Kin 19:30 למ ׳שֹׁרֶשׁ (compare Ph CIS 1. i. 2, 11 f. למעל ופר למט שׁרשׁ לם יכן אל let them not have root downwards , or fruit upwards), Jer 31:37 ; Eccl 3:21 ; 2Chr 32:30 ; Ezra 9:13 מֵעֲוֺנֵנוּ לְמַ֫טָּה חָשַׂכְתָּ אתה כי either (Be) hast kept back, downward , part of our iniquity (prevented it from appearing, and being counted against us), or, held us (Ges), or thy anger (Ke), back, below (compare מֵעַל לְמַ֫עְלָה above , 2Chr 34:4 ) our iniq. (punished us less than our iniq. deserved). b. וּלְמַ֫טָּה , ( a ) of space, and downwards , Ezek 1:27 ול מָתְנָיו ׳וּמִמַּרְאֵה , 8:2 ; ( b ) of age, and under , 1Chr 17:23 וְ ׳שׁנה עשׂרים לְמִבֶּן . 3 מִלְּמַ֫טָּה beneath (see מִן 9a: opposed to מִלְמַעְלָה above ), Exod 26:24 = 36:29 ; 27:5 = 38:4 , 28:27 = 39:20 .
